process_issues.description: PR #649 smoke claimed PASS, vbeta.18.37 was cut from that merge, and a user-flow critical path (collaborator add) regressed on the same release without any pre-release smoke covering that surface.
process_issues.lesson: The smoke scope for a release should cover at least the previous release's known-fixed surfaces, not only the PR's specific acceptance criteria. The #644 collaborator-add path was last smoked on a debug build 24h before the vbeta.18.37 tag.

process_issues.description: Both UI entry points for collaborator add/remove silently swallow thrown AppErrors. This is a class of regression where the smoke ladder cannot distinguish 'works' from 'fails silently'.
process_issues.lesson: Any UI call that fronts an HTTP write should have a mandatory error-surface affordance (toast/banner/inline). Lint or review-checklist item: try/catch with user-visible failure path or an explicit comment why the error is intentionally swallowed.
